description: Phase 67 political-transfer contract fixture: bounded same-region clusters, retained cores, reverse locks, and recovery immunity.
luaCommands: lua cmd local steppe=find.player(5); local franks=find.player(0); local besh=nil; local sarai=nil; local kara=nil; for city in steppe:cities_iterate() do if city.name == "Beshbalik" then besh=city elseif city.name == "Sarai" then sarai=city elseif city.name == "Karakorum" then kara=city end end; organic_history_transfer_city(besh, franks, "political_secession", "phase67_cluster"); organic_history_transfer_city(sarai, franks, "political_secession", "phase67_cluster"); organic_history_transfer_city(sarai, franks, "political_secession", "phase67_second"); organic_history_transfer_city(kara, franks, "political_secession", "phase67_last_core"); organic_history_transfer_city(besh, steppe, "political_succession", "phase67_reverse")

lua cmd local chola=find.player(3); local franks=find.player(0); local first=nil; for city in chola:cities_iterate() do first=city; break end; organic_history_transfer_city(first, franks, "political_succession", "phase67_recovery")

lua cmd function phase67_recovery_attempt(turn) if turn == 2 then local chola=find.player(3); local franks=find.player(0); for city in chola:cities_iterate() do organic_history_transfer_city(city, franks, "political_secession", "phase67_recovery_followup"); return end end end; signal.connect("turn_begin", "phase67_recovery_attempt")
name: phase67_political_transfer_contract
